question: 用 ast 解析 scripts/scanner_regression.py 的 FAMILIES 字面量，它声明的回归用例总条数是多少？
verify:
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import scripts.scanner_regression as sr
ROOT = Path(sr.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "scripts/scanner_regression.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
node = next(n.value for n in tree.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and getattr(n.targets[0], "id", "") == "FAMILIES")
fams = ast.literal_eval(node)
result = sum(len(v["manifest"]) for v in fams.values())
